lines.text: (The two people slowly enter the magic academy building.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, why are you so quiet?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I didn't know that I would come all the way to the magic academy to look for a lost cat.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I had no choice because it was Old Man Martelli’s request. They say you can't leave a stray cat alone for some reason.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There is such a thing, Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Hey, leader… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Even though it's an empire, I know that Rivera is also providing financial help to the mercenaries... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Where on earth is all that money being spent?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Do you want to know? Before that, I have something more to ask. Why does Calone hate coming this way?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Okay, that's enough. Let's stop. Anyway, all you have to do is look at Zephyrus and Chloris... . Oh, there's a student at Zerenis Magic Academy.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Hey, student. Have you ever seen a cat like this here? If you look at the flyer here, you will see that it has light brown fur and blue eyes… . Now, wait… .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: (Calone spots a female student and stops to hand out the leaflets in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: There are no cats here. Aren't you in the wrong place? Uh, you guys… .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Well, you saw it wrong. We are cats looking for lost mercenaries. Oh, no. no. A passing cat, no... . Phew… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: … Mr. Calone, you are confused.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: My words came out in vain. Please forgive my rudeness. By the way, what is your noble person doing here?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That's what I'd like to ask, Mr. Calone. I'm just a student here, what's going on here?  Is this the Magic Agency’s job…? .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That's not it. I am… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: If so, please come separately later. The principal and chairman are not there right now. Wait a minute. But the person who came with me… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina finds Parmilla, who was hidden behind Calone.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Do you know the manager?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Manager? Ah, a mercenary group… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is this what old Martelly said about finding the cat? . I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmilla comes in front of Calone and smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It’s been a while, kitten. Princess Shiina Dawn Sylvaria. You also know Calone, and your network is wider than you think?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: … It's just Shiina here, Farr.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: (...I think something annoying will happen...)
